name: Genkan Aketara Nifun de Ecchi
original_name: 玄関開けたら2分でえっち
source:
Yuzo Yamamiya was a 38-year-old company man who women seemed to dislike.

He had money thanks to a lifetime of nothing but work, but no friends, and the opposite of sex appeal.

When the company sent him to a new location life was pretty much same.
Nobody to say goodbye to, nobody to say hello to. He was just existing, like always.
While apartment hunting even the women at the leasing agency seemed put off.

Yuzo found a new place and started to live there, but......

From here, please enjoy a new kind of mystery-suspense experience with "2 Minutes Beyond the Doorway".

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE141461.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
山宫雄三是一位38岁的公司男人，似乎受到女性的厌恶。

他之所以有钱，是因为他一生除了工作什么都没有，却没有朋友，而且与性感相反。

当公司派他到一个新地点时，他的生活几乎没有什么变化。
没有人可以说再见，也没有人可以打招呼。他只是存在，就像往常一样。
在寻找公寓时，就连租赁机构的女性似乎也被推迟了。

勇三找到了一个新地方并开始在那里生活，但是……

从这里开始，请享受《门外两分钟》的全新悬疑体验。
